requirement_text.ISS-0332: REQ-077 bumped the DEFINITION_PROMOTED platform-event-type seed from schema_version 1 (review_id required non-null) to schema_version 2 (review_id nullable) in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, to support R10 (Promotion.promote_active_definition/5, ENV-03 review-less promote path). This seed only applies to tenants provisioned from this point forward -- nothing re-runs replay_migrations/2 or re-registers the type for already-provisioned tenants, whose event_type_registry still validates against v1. R10 against such a tenant commits the promotion transaction, then fails the event-append step on schema validation -- a committed write reported as failure (Severity 1). Needs a backfill routine (e.g. a Mix task iterating tenant_schemas and calling Letflow.EventStore.Registry.register_type/2 per tenant, no-op on an already-higher-version collision) -- should go through CODE-DESIGNER before implementation. Affected files: lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex.

task.description:
Perform WF-03 Steps 0.5 and 1 for ISS-0332.

Step 0.5 — Registry Lookup: Check docs/issues/*.yaml for any resolved entries with matching symptoms (same DEFINITION_PROMOTED schema_version gap class). If a match is found, determine whether the same root cause has recurred or if this is a genuinely new manifestation. Complete the lookup and record findings.

Step 1 — Diagnose: Root-cause the failure. ISS-0332's description and docs/issues/ISS-0332.yaml give good context, but verify by reading the actual code:
- lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex: Find the @platform_event_type_seed_attrs list, specifically DEFINITION_PROMOTED at schema_version 2. Note the KNOWN GAP comment in the description field -- this is the code's own self-documented admission.
- lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex: Read register_type/2 and the monotonicity check to understand how {:error, :duplicate_event_type_version} and {:error, :schema_version_not_monotonic} are returned.
- lib/letflow/routers/tenants.ex: Find R10 (the ENV-03 promote_active_definition/5 route) to understand how it calls the event store and what happens when the schema validation fails.

Document the root cause, not just the symptom. The root cause is: maybe_seed_platform_event_types/2 only seeds event types during replay_migrations/2 for the current @platform_event_type_seed_attrs list -- there is no mechanism to re-seed or upgrade event type schema_versions for tenants already provisioned before @platform_event_type_seed_attrs was changed. R10 calls the event appender after committing the promotion transaction; if that tenant's event_type_registry still has DEFINITION_PROMOTED at schema_version 1 (review_id type 'string', not ['string','null']), validate_payload/3 fails on a null review_id, returning {error, {:payload_validation_failed, ...}}, leaving the promotion committed but the audit event unemitted -- a Severity-1 broken-audit shape.

After diagnosis: state what a fix needs to do. Do NOT implement the fix.

Complete both steps in a single handoff result.
acceptance_criteria: Step 0.5: docs/issues/ checked for prior resolved entries with the same schema_version backfill class; findings stated
Step 1: root cause identified as specific function and code path, not just symptom
Step 1: affected functions named (register_type/2, maybe_seed_platform_event_types/2, validate_payload/3 path through R10)
Step 1: fix direction stated -- sufficient for CODE-DESIGNER to design from
